note: Dubuque County Conservation park near Holy Cross: 140 acres of wooded hillside sloping to a grassy meadow along the spring-fed, trout-stocked Middle Fork of the Little Maquoketa (Bankston Creek). Primitive sites in the open meadow and beside a small fishing pond, a restroom and algific talus slopes. Creek is behind a tree belt from the sites. --Claude
summary: Changed: 50 sites -> 8 primitive, electric 30 -> 0 (no hookups), max_rig_ft 30 -> cleared, booking some_sites/reservable -> FCFS self-registration. No rate found. Not waterfront confirmed.
flags: SITES / ELECTRIC: the operator's page says '8 primitive campsites', and the county map draws sites 1-8. The stored '~50 sites, electric (30-amp, slated to upgrade to 50-amp), max RV ~30 ft' matches aggregator listings (allstays: 50 sites / 30 ft max). It isn't on any county page, so the 30-amp upgrade claim is unsupported and dropped. I set electric to 0 because the operator calls every site primitive. inclusion_evidence also repeats the 50-site / 30-ft claim and should be refreshed.

RATE NOT FOUND: the park page gives no fee and lists no bookable campsite facilities, so there's no /Availability page with a fee. Dubuque County's own site (dubuquecountyiowa.gov) search and park URL didn't give a Bankston page (/542/Bankston-Park returns a falcon photo gallery). The Dyrt's '$12-24' is an aggregator figure and wasn't used. Rate lead: the self-registration kiosk on site, or the park phone (563) 556-6745. The fees group stays absent.

FIT (OK, caveat optional): no length is posted. The map draws every site with a trailer icon, and on NAIP sites 1-6 are an open mown meadow (about 120 x 100 m) entered by a gravel spur, with vehicles parked at its edges. Sites 7-8 are by the gravel parking lot at the pond. There's no clear limit under 23 ft. If AWH wants a caveat: 'Grass meadow sites, no pads posted.'

WATERFRONT confirmed not waterfront. The creek (a trout stream, about 5-10 m wide, so creekside at best) runs along the meadow's NE side behind a 20-40 m tree and brush belt on NAIP. The map's stream line beside sites 4-6 is schematic. Sites 7-8 sit by the fishing pond, which is about 85 x 55 m on NAIP (~1 acre), a pond by the 5-acre rule, so no value.

BOOKING: the stored 'Partial online reservations via mycountyparks.com, remainder FCFS' isn't supported. Dubuque's reservable parks (Mud Lake, New Wine, Heritage, Massey, Fillmore) each list their campsites as facilities, and Bankston lists none. The map shows a self-registration kiosk. So I set reservable false / fcfs always. It's an inference from absence plus the kiosk; no page says 'first come, first served'.
SEASON: 'April through November' gives no start or end day, so opens and closes are left unset. The page also links off-season/hunting information (public hunting in the park in season).
PIN OK: 42.55789,-90.95709 is on Bankston Park Road about 80 m NW of the meadow (sites 1-6, centroid about 42.5576,-90.9561) and about 180 m W of the pond lot (sites 7-8). Under the 250 m line.
PHONE OK: (563) 556-6745 is on the park page, with the address 17826 Bankston Park Road, Holy Cross, IA 52053. Website OK.
